Winner was iterative:data_width=15,n_iter=16,angle_guard=1,frac_guard=1,rounding=trunc at luts_plus_ffs=264 (170 LUT / 94 FF), accuracy_bits=10.7, throughput 10.4 MSPS — i.e. ~10x throughput headroom over the 1 MSPS constraint, so the binding constraint is accuracy, not speed. Also: specs without a system scenario leave L2 selection unchanged (only DDS SFDR/SNR facts).
